## 8. Workload Resource Tiering & Network Blast-Radius Protection Strategy

To protect core network services (Pi-hole v6 FTL and DHCP) from resource starvation, memory pressure, or I/O bottlenecking, all Pi 5 workloads are strictly partitioned into 4 operational tiers:

```text
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                          PI 5 WORKLOAD RESOURCE ISOLATION ARCHITECTURE                  │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ TIER 1: CRITICAL NETWORK SERVICES (Always On | High Priority | Nice=-10)               │
│ - Pi-hole v6 FTL (Port 53 DNS & DHCP) [~58MB RAM | <0.5% CPU]                          │
│ - Dual DNS HA Broadcast (DHCP Option 6 -> 192.168.1.92, 192.168.1.80)                 │
│ - Tailscale Subnet Router (100.68.196.14) [~90MB RAM | <0.5% CPU]                      │
│ - Network Intrusion Monitor (Scapy sniffer) [~40MB RAM | <0.5% CPU]                    │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ TIER 2: LIGHTWEIGHT LOCAL SERVICES (Docker | Idle 0% CPU | Combined <500MB RAM)        │
│ - TripDrop Staging Portal (Port 8088 FastAPI chunked uploads)                          │
│ - Stirling-PDF Utility (Port 8083 Docker OCR & PDF transforms)                         │
│ - n8n Workflow Automation (Port 5678 Docker workflow engine)                           │
│ - SecondBrain / Gitea (ChromaDB + Git hooks)                                           │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ TIER 3: CPU-BOUND AI / ML WORKLOADS (Throttled / On-Demand / Batch Jobs Only)           │
│ - WhisperX Meeting Indexer (Nice=15, CPUQuota=60%, INT8 CPU inference)                 │
│ - Ollama / Local RAG (keep_alive="5m", auto-unloads model weights when idle)           │
│ - Voice Clone Sandbox (On-demand synthesis CLI, never continuous daemon)               │
│ - Morning Briefing Generator (One-shot daily systemd timer at 06:00 AM)                │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ TIER 4: HEAVY GPU TRANSCODING & MEDIA (Offloaded 100% to UGREEN NAS 192.168.1.80)      │
│ - Plex Media Server (Intel QuickSync GPU passthrough /dev/dri/renderD128)              │
│ - 8-Service *Arr Automation Stack (Radarr, Sonarr, Prowlarr, qBittorrent, etc.)        │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Safety Rules Enforced:
1. **Never Run Concurrent CPU-Bound AI Loops**: Whisper, XTTS v2, and Ollama must never run concurrently as persistent busy loops. They execute as isolated on-demand or scheduled jobs.
2. **Dual-DNS Redundancy via DHCP Option 6**: `dhcp-option=6,192.168.1.92,192.168.1.80` ensures that even during unexpected node reboots or heavy loads, all client devices automatically fall back to the hardwired UGREEN NAS with zero downtime.
3. **Process Priority Protection**: `pihole-FTL` runs with `Nice=-10` and `OOMScoreAdjust=-1000`, guaranteeing that the Linux kernel will never starve or kill DNS/DHCP.
